types.description: The ordinary language of Houdini. Cards about reflection, movement, relationships and everyday change.
Cards that depend on where you have already been. Chance alone may not be enough.
Hidden structures, inaccessible paths and states that require specific journeys to reach.
Cards that do not completely obey the rules of the deck.
Hidden cards connected to the history and mythology surrounding Houdini. Their number and conditions are undisclosed.
